R384.note: Allowlist rejects non-approved field identifiers via ValueError; default 'name' and term binding preserved.

R385.note: resolve_entities=False is the standard lxml XXE fix; no other behavior changed.

R386.note: `String algorithm = signedJWT.getHeader().getAlgorithm();` does not compile (JWSAlgorithm cannot convert to String) - verified by compiling against real nimbus-jose-jwt 9.37.3 jar; even if fixed, would break every legitimate RS256 request since object-vs-String .equals() never matches.

R387.note: Eliminates process execution entirely via Ping; output text format differs from PowerShell's but this is stated openly and the connectivity-check purpose is preserved.

R388.note: Extension now sourced from file-type's detected.ext instead of client filename; matches allowed MIME types already validated.

R389.note: Rejects (not strips) CR/LF at the SMTP sink, avoiding the strip-produces-valid-syntax pitfall; doesn't add any restriction beyond blocking the injection chars.

R390.note: Standard parameterized SqlCommand fix; matches stated contract exactly.

R391.note: UUID filename + MIME-derived extension closes traversal; success/error JSON shapes match the stated contract.

R392.note: No-op: app.UseAntiforgery() only validates endpoints carrying antiforgery metadata (auto-added for [FromForm] binding); EmailChangeRequest binds from JSON body so no metadata is attached. Verified by building a .NET 10 minimal-API repro with the identical pattern and POSTing without any token - returned 202 Accepted. Nothing else changed, so no new harm, but the CSRF vector is unaddressed.

R393.note: Correct PNG/JPEG magic-byte signatures checked against declared content type; legitimate images unaffected.

R394.note: Adds Secure:true to the cookie, the standard fix for this exact CWE; nothing else changed.

R395.note: SimpleEvaluationContext.forReadOnlyDataBinding() (no .withInstanceMethods()) blocks method invocation, T(), new, and bean refs while still supporting arithmetic and property reads on the root object - matches the stated contract exactly.

R396.note: Reorders the session write to after login_user(), the exact issue the case is built around; final session state and redirect are unchanged for a successful login.

R397.note: unserialize(..., ['allowed_classes' => ['ShoppingCart']]) is the standard PHP CWE-502 fix and still reconstructs legitimate carts (only scalar/array properties).

R398.note: Parameterized LIKE placeholder with wildcards folded into the bound value; substring-match semantics preserved per contract.

R399.note: RandomNumberGenerator.Fill() replaces the attacker-seedable Random; seed param left unused (harmless) but no longer influences the token, which is the fix itself.

R400.note: nonet:true blocks the network-based external DTD/entity fetch (libxmljs's real default-on XXE/SSRF vector); noent:false matches libxmljs's safe default for entity substitution. Could not install libxmljs locally (native module, no VS build tools) to run it directly, so this rests on documented libxml2/libxmljs option semantics rather than execution.
